references.text: Psalm 112:5 - Blessed is the one who is gracious and lends, who conducts their affairs with justice.

Matthew 21:28-31 - The parable of the two sons, where one says he will not go out to work in the vineyard but later changes his mind and goes, while the other says he will go but does not. This shows the importance of backing up words with actions.
Luke 19:12-26 - The parable of the minas, which is similar to the parable of the talents, emphasizing the importance of being faithful with what has been entrusted to you.
1 Peter 4:10 - Each one should use whatever gift they have received to serve others, as good stewards of God's varied grace.
